name: Pinochle Three Player
description: Three-player Pinochle: each plays for themselves. Deal 15 cards each and a 3-card kitty. Auction to name trump (min 20, or 19 for dealer); high bidder takes the kitty, declares trump, and all meld. Fifteen tricks; follow suit, trump when void. First to 100 points wins. Must take at least one trick to count meld; fail contract costs the bid amount.

content.text: Three-player Pinochle: each plays for themselves. Deal 15 cards each and a 3-card kitty. Auction to name trump (min 20, or 19 for dealer); high bidder takes the kitty, declares trump, and all meld. Fifteen tricks; follow suit, trump when void. First to 100 points wins. Must take at least one trick to count meld; fail contract costs the bid amount.

Pinochle descends from the European game Bezique, either as a cousin of Binokel or directly from the Swiss and South German game Binocle (Binokel), which is itself a descendant of Bezique. German immigrants brought Binokel to America in the last quarter of the 19th century, where the name was mispronounced and misspelled as pinochle. The game became a favorite among American Jewish and Irish immigrants. The three-player auction variant developed in the United States; its bidding has similarities to German Skat and to bid whist. During World War I the game was briefly outlawed in Syracuse, New York, and some other US cities due to anti-German sentiment, but it has since regained broad popularity.
Three players; each plays for themselves.
48-card Pinochle deck (two copies of 9 through Ace in each of four suits).
Dealer deals 15 cards to each player and 3 cards to the kitty (middle). Deal rotates clockwise; packets of three or four at a time, starting with player to dealer's left.

items.text: Cutthroat: No kitty. Deal entire deck: 16 cards each. Win only by bidding and making contract to reach winning score; high score without a winning bid does not win.

Check: Gambling variant; same as to 100 but players track checks (e.g. stakes). Flush/run, aces, roundtable earn checks; looking at talon and losing costs checks; double marriage, double pinochle, double arounds earn extra.
